title: An Acoustic Study of Stops in the Chenghai Dialect
token_or_recording_size: public WAV archive plus TextGrid archive and acoustic workbook
annotation_target: VOT; stop closure duration (GAP); segment/landmark timing
manual_scope: Authoritative repository description states that the Praat TextGrids manually mark VOT and closure duration (GAP).
decision_reason: Primary non-singing speech production with publicly deposited audio, manually annotated phonetic landmarks, and derived acoustic measurements.
evidence_summary: Repository record identifies primary field recordings from native Chenghai speakers and three public data products: wav.zip, textgrid.zip with manual Praat annotations, and data analysis.xlsx with VOT/GAP measurements.
